description: Create a private document or folder in the user's Replo Files. Documents require a source: inline text, inline base64, or an asset already in this Replo project (copied; the asset stays). Nothing is fetched from a URL or an outside service. Folders have no source. Name conflicts never overwrite. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

source.description: Required when kind is file. Omit when kind is folder. Inline text, inline base64, or an asset already in this Replo project; nothing is fetched from a URL or an outside service.

name: create_file
title: Create file
